metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the enemy was just a walking bullet magnet LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, why did that even hit? I wasn’t aiming anywhere near!
Enemy must’ve been playing hide and seek... without hiding.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still hands you kills!

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but you still get that kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
